about: How sure the model is about each feature, for the map and Overview 'Sure / unsure' overlay (docs/CONFIDENCE.md). scripts/build_confidence.py gives every feature in the shared inventory a default level; entries here override it with a reason, record the owner's decision, or mark a known gap (something visibly there that is not modelled). A level is a judgement for the game, not placement approval (docs/PLACEMENT_VERIFICATION.md).

levels.photographed: Clearly photographed: what it is and how it fits its neighbours is clear in the photos. Sizes and exact map position can still be off by up to about a metre.
levels.estimated: Seen in photos, but only partly (one angle, cropped, distant or behind planting): its shape, size or extent is estimated.
levels.inferred: Not seen directly: built from the aerial, the levels survey or what must be there.
levels.registry: Official land-registry footprint: the outline is reliable, the whole map sits about 1-1.5 m off the laser survey.

decisions.accepted: Good enough for the game; no more work planned.

gaps.why: The garden wall, door, pergola and one dividing wall (inferred from the aerial) are built; the rest of the patios behind them (further partitions, floors, levels) is hidden under the magnolia canopy in the roof photos, so it is empty in the model.

gaps.name: CALLE ELENA 25 · covered passage and inner courtyard
gaps.why: The photos show a covered passage into this block and the aerial a planted courtyard; the model draws the block solid (task elena-25-passage).

gaps.name: CALLE ELENA 18-36 walkway · two steps and ramp at the east portal
gaps.why: Two risers and a red ribbed ramp up into the walkway (levels survey elena-walkway-east-steps); not modelled.

gaps.name: Cervantes junction · lane-edge wall east of the garden-door planter
gaps.why: The 0.65 m lane-edge wall stands about 0.3 m further out than the planter front in the photos; it may be the same planter continuing east.

gaps.name: North pool · spreading tree leaning over the north-west raised terrace
gaps.why: Located through the solved IMG_2204 camera (trunk foot on the terrace floor, about -193.0, 20.8, crown about 6 m across), but its crown overlaps the protected walk across the terrace, so the route-clearance guard keeps it out. Needs a decision on whether a tree over a walk may stand there.

gaps.name: Barraka building facade: north-east window rows and timber band, glazed frontage with red awnings and lettering, thatched edge
gaps.why: Registry floors 1 (3 m) and the laser survey roof 2.9-3.7 m disagree with the two-level wall seen in the photos (about 4.5-5 m); the building mass is unchanged and none of the openings, awnings or lettering are modelled until the height is settled (task barraka-facade).

gaps.name: White framed shelter on the sand beside Barraka's deck
gaps.why: IMG_2631, from under the awning, shows a white timber frame with a roof on the sand west of the lounge. One oblique view does not fix its footprint, so it is not built.

gaps.name: Barraka thatched cooking shelter, net-covered mound and kayaks on the sand
gaps.why: Clear in IMG_2619 (open timber shelter with a thatched pitched roof and white board walls) but its footprint depends on the camera pin and the disputed aisle position; no second bearing, so it is not placed (see barraka-barbecue-boat).

gaps.name: Barraka slot drains along the glazed wall and across the terrace paving
gaps.why: Black grating strips are visible in three photos from weak pins (+-4 to +-7 m) under the awning; their lines are not fixed, so none is drawn.

gaps.name: Pintor Dalí · house arches, palms and the seaward modern lamp
gaps.why: The aisle curb, plinth, hedge and black lanterns are built. Each house's arches, shuttered windows, balcony grilles, palms and bougainvillea are still the generated facade kit, and the modern flat lamp at the turning area is a different fitting from the black lanterns.

gaps.name: Patricia covered passage (CALLE DE PATRICIA arch to the Silvia 22-44 mouth)
gaps.why: A chain of arches with doors, pebble mats and a ramp is photographed but its route, bends and length are not traced (camera pins +-2.4-5 m, mostly indoors). Not modelled.

gaps.name: Covered passage off Calle Eva (brown double doors, potted trees)
gaps.why: Same passage family as the Silvia passages, seen from a pin inside the block (+-4.5 m); which passage and street is not established. Not modelled.

gaps.name: Plants in the raised planter on Calle Eva west
gaps.why: The planter is built, but its shrubs and flowers sit inside the protected walking route (the mapped Eva line runs along the planter), so the Details guard leaves them out.

gaps.name: Climbers and shrubs against the house walls on Calle Eva west
gaps.why: The bougainvillea and jasmine up the house walls behind the west beds are not modelled; the east wall climbers are (eva-planting-shapes).

gaps.name: Covered passage from the Calle Alberto 22-40 porch to the inner courtyard
gaps.why: IMG_2792 shows only the porch; which way the passage turns behind the back wall, and its width, height and line through the house, are unseen, so it is not cut through the registry house in 3D (photo request calle-alberto-22-40-inside).

gaps.name: Calle Jorge 56 to 86 m: house fronts, walls, planters, doors and the CALLE JORGE 27 35 passage
gaps.why: Since 14 November the path, lawns, a tree and a portal are built from the aerial between the gateway and 86 m (inferred). What is still left out because nothing shows it: the house fronts, garden walls, planters, lamps and house numbers between the house rows from 56 to 86 m, and the mouth of the CALLE JORGE 27 35 passage (IMG_2185-2187 show it only from inside).

gaps.name: Barraka thatched cooking shelter, net-covered mound and kayaks
gaps.why: IMG_2619 shows a thatched shelter, a net-covered mound and kayaks on the sand left of the green aisle. The shelter's footprint is not measured, so it is not built (see also barraka-barbecue-boat).

gaps.name: Slot drains along Barraka's glazed wall and across the terrace
gaps.why: A slot drain runs along the glazed wall and across the terrace paving. The paving widening and the drain line are not traced, so they are not built. The sandbags on the drain are temporary.

gaps.name: Shop storey at the head of Enrique's steps
gaps.why: The photos show a white storey with glazed shop fronts and a curved fin wall on the street-level terrace; the model has only the terrace roof, so the shop awnings have no wall behind them. Task enrique-shop-storey.

gaps.name: Further service lids on the main-pool lawn
gaps.why: One or two more square grey lids show in photos whose pins are 10-18 m vague, so only the IMG_2761 lid is built.

gaps.name: Plumbago either side of the beach gate
gaps.why: Blue plumbago spills over the white walls either side of the gate on the paseo side; not modelled yet (task main-pool-gate-corner).

gaps.name: Sandstone-faced wall with green mesh down the slope
gaps.why: From the paseo the boundary south-west of the gate is a sandstone-faced wall topped with green rigid mesh; the model draws a plain white wall there (task main-pool-gate-corner).

gaps.name: Louvred service doors on the lawn kiosk
gaps.why: White louvred double doors on the kiosk's lawn side; the kiosk is built plain without them (request kiosk-faces).

gaps.name: What lies south of the north pool's hedges
gaps.why: The station camera stands on the roof south of the hedges and cannot see between them and the south row; the two paths that leave the lawn south (one along the hibiscus hedge, one through the gap) run out of view. Not modelled.

gaps.name: Moulded window surrounds on the north row
gaps.why: The north row's windows have raised white surrounds with cornices and ornamental crests over the ground-floor doors (IMG_2204 x 470-570, 955-1075; IMG_2205 x 250-390); the facade kit draws plain generated openings. Task facade-kit-traced.

gaps.name: Archway into the east block from Calle Isabel
gaps.why: IMG_2205 (x 1330-1440, y 580-630) shows a wide arched opening in the east block's ground floor onto Calle Isabel, with a grey parasol in the covered space behind; the facade kit draws generated openings there.

gaps.name: Large creeper on the block beside the station camera
gaps.why: IMG_2206 (x 250-580, y 730-1100) shows a big leafy evergreen creeper covering the lower west face of the near block; not modelled.

gaps.name: North and south sides of the walled patio
gaps.why: The roof station sees only the patio's west and east walls; what closes it on the north (towards the west path) and the south (towards the block by the camera) is hidden, so those sides are left open rather than walled by guess.

gaps.name: Iron gate and its wall at the head of Calle Isabel
gaps.why: IMG_2205 (x 1000-1140, y 520-600) shows a black iron gate between white walls where Calle Isabel leaves the lawn, at about (-162.55..-161.8, 7.2-7.5); not modelled, so an open passage shows there.

gaps.name: Generated low wall behind the yucca on Calle Isabel
gaps.why: A generated low wall and gate stand at about (-159.8..-159.5, 17.5-19.0); the yucca hides that ground in IMG_2205, so whether a wall is there is unknown and the generated one is left.

gaps.name: Patio dividers further north behind the Elena garden wall
gaps.why: The registry face of 6265401UF1366N_part3 jogs at two more party walls (about z 38.5 and 35), where patio dividers would normally run to the garden wall, but the magnolia canopy hides that ground on the aerial and in the roof photos (IMG_2366 looks south of Cervantes, not into these patios); not built rather than guessed (photo request elena-east-patios-inside).

gaps.name: Calle Jorge at Calle Silvia · white wall round the north-east corner of the south-pool lawn
gaps.why: The Esri and Google aerials show a white wall with a curved corner where the south-pool lawn meets Calle Jorge at Calle Silvia (about 51-55 m along Jorge), running south along the lawn's east side. IMG_2280 and IMG_2697 see this stretch only through the gateway from about 25 m and show the second white portal, not the wall. Not built: its line, height and how it meets the portal are not known (photo request jorge-silvia-junction).

gaps.name: Calle Jorge east stretch · gaps between the south-side house blocks
gaps.why: The registry house fronts on the lawn side step back to about 11 m at 101-108 m and 121-125 m. The aerials show these recesses in deep shadow and do not show whether a wall closes them at the house-front line, so the lawn and open ground run into them in the model (photo request jorge-east-house-fronts).

gaps.name: Cervantes east · white seat pillar and two brick-edged flights into the north garden
gaps.why: IMG_2442 and IMG_2443 show a white seat with an azulejo-tiled pillar and two brick-edged steps up into the north garden beside it (gap left at 118.4-120.2 m along the lane), and a second brick-edged flight about 4-5 m west of it at about 114-115 m (gap left at 113.8-115.4 m). Not built: the garden behind and the height they climb to are not visible.

gaps.name: Cervantes east of Elena · second door in the south wall
gaps.why: IMG_2795 and IMG_2796 show a brown door in the south wall at about 72.5 m along the lane, on the existing wall of data/cervantes_east_south_patios.json, which models one door only (at 61.7 m). Not added here: that feature has its own review.

gaps.name: Cervantes east · lawn and low rounded kerb on the south side by the seat
gaps.why: From about 119 m to the end house (123.5 m) IMG_2443 shows lawn behind a low kerb and a low rounded white wall near the camera, not the hedge planter. Not built: the lawn edge is not traced.

gaps.name: Cervantes at Alberto · the south wall turning down Calle Alberto
gaps.why: IMG_2448 shows the tall south wall turning the corner at about 93 m, its ALBERTO-plaque face running south along Calle Alberto, with a clipped hedge about 1.5 m tall in front of it at the corner. The lane-side wall stops at the corner; the return and the hedge are not built, because Calle Alberto south of Cervantes is not traced.

gaps.name: Elena north · lower bed along the house front north of the corner
gaps.why: A lower kerbed bed with a trained climber runs along the house under its barred windows north of the raised corner bed (IMG_2686, IMG_2969); not modelled (discrepancy elena-north-west-lower-bed).

gaps.name: Pintor Dalí · green bollard lamps with white globes on the lawn strip
gaps.why: Short green bollard lamps with white globes stand on the lawn by the path kerb (IMG_3082-3084); not placed. The main-pool lawn bollard model (public/models/lawn/bollard.glb) may fit; their spacing needs a longer view.
